title: Square of the Derivative Threshold Sum
statement: Let $p:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. For each coordinate $i$, let $D_i p(x)$ be half the difference between the values of $p$ when coordinate $i$ is set to $1$ and to $-1$, and let $q_i(x)$ be $1$ if $D_i p(x)\geq0$ and $-1$ otherwise. Then $\left(\sum_i x_iq_i(x)\right)^2=n+\sum_i\sum_{j\ne i}x_ix_jq_i(x)q_j(x)$.
